x.ets2.link: ETS2: the cost per litre of diesel from 2028
x.ets2.title: ETS2 from 2028: what it adds per litre of diesel
x.ets2.h1: ETS2 from 2028: the cost per litre of diesel
x.ets2.lead: From 2028 the EU's second emissions trading system (ETS2) puts a price on the CO2 of road fuel: fuel suppliers buy an allowance per tonne of CO2 their fuel emits and pass it on in the price. At {kg} kg CO2 per litre of diesel, each €10 per tonne adds {per10} per litre.
x.ets2.body1: ETS2 is Chapter IVa of the {directive}, added by Directive (EU) 2023/959. It covers fuel released for consumption for road transport, buildings and further sectors. The amended European Climate Law, adopted by the Council on 5 March 2026, moved its start from 2027 to 2028.
x.ets2.body2: The price is set by the market; the table works it out for a range of prices. Per litre: price × {kg} kg ÷ 1,000. The {kg} kg is diesel's tank-to-wheel CO2 per litre in EN 16258:2012, Annex A, the factor the calculator uses for taxes per litre.
x.ets2.body3: For the CO2 prices on diesel that countries charge today, see {link}.
x.ets2.note: The calculator prices ETS2 on a trip's road fuel from 2028 at the price you give (ets2_eur_per_t).

x.fuel.lead: {n} European countries put a CO2 price on diesel of their own, on top of fuel excise duty: per tonne of CO2 or per litre. The rates in force on {date}, per litre of diesel in euros.
x.fuel.note1: Per tonne of CO2 converts to per litre at {kg} kg CO2 per litre of diesel (EN 16258:2012, Annex A). Other currencies at the ECB reference rate (DKK at its ERM II central rate).
x.fuel.note2: The calculator charges these on the fuel a trip burns in each country (or where you say the fuel is bought).
